Subject: SeekData ranking pilot — scope, SDK auth, and eval check-in

Hi Elena / Raj —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can line up the tech deep-dive: 

1) Goal: run a 4-week pilot to validate a reranker on your search intent logs (web + app) and measure relevance gains and latency/cost tradeoffs. Target: +8–12% relative improvement in nDCG@10, with 95th perc latency < 250ms for reranker-only path.

2) What we need from you (please prioritize):
   - A sample of ~5k anonymized query-candidate pairs + relevance labels (or a smaller human-labeled set and a larger implicit-feedback set). CSV sample attached: seekdata_sample_queries.csv.
   - Indicate whether retrieval will supply an embeddings-based candidate set or via your current search engine (Elasticsearch).
   - Security constraints: do you need traffic to go over VPC/private deployment or is hosted acceptable for initial evaluation?

3) Technical checklist (we'll cover in the tech deep-dive):
   - SDK setup + auth model (API key vs short-lived token vs SSO/OAuth).
   - Routing & fallback policy for candidate retrieval -> reranker -> generation.
   - Structured output/tool-calling expectations (e.g., filters, metadata pass-through).
   - Embeddings: do you want us to produce embeddings server-side or accept your vectors?
   - Reranker evaluation matrix: proposed metrics below.

4) Proposed evaluation metrics: MRR, nDCG@5/10, Recall@k (k=100), pairwise human preference (A/B), and a latency/cost per-query dashboard. We'll also instrument a small human eval for 300 queries.

5) Quick ask: please confirm the sample data upload link (we've provided a Drive folder — see link below) and your security contact for SOC2 / network requirements.

Attachments: seekdata_sample_queries.csv, redwood_rerank_playbook_v1.pdf

Next step: Can we schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive next week (engineers + infra) to walk through SDK auth and a sample integration? I'm available Tue/Wed 10–2 PT.

Cheers,
Priyom

Folks — quick technical notes ahead of the deep-dive. TL;DR: recommended defaults + data/metric instrumentation.

Recommended pilot defaults
- Candidate set sizing: retrieve top_k=100 (for candidate pool) into the reranker. That gives a good balance for nDCG@10 evaluation and keeps reranker cost reasonable.
- Reranker model: cross-encoder (input: [query] + [candidate doc up to 512 tokens]) with batch size 32 for GPU inference. For CPU-hosted evaluation, we can run a lightweight bi-encoder as a baseline.
- Tokenization: truncate/doc windowing for long documents; pass metadata fields (doc_id, source) in the structured payload so we can debug ranking errors.

Auth & SDK
- For rapid POC: short-lived API tokens scoped to the pilot project are fine. We'll issue tokens limited to the pilot workspace and eval endpoints. For production, we support OIDC/OAuth SSO with Okta and SCIM for user mapping.
- SDK: we have a Node/Python client. Sample inference call (pseudo-JSON):

  POST /v1/rank
  Headers: Authorization: Bearer <SCOPED_TOKEN>
  Body: {
    "query": "best laptop for data science",
    "candidates": [ {"id":"doc_342","text":"...","meta":{} } , ... ],
    "return_scores": true,
    "structured_output": ["doc_id","source","relevance_score"]
  }

Routing/fallback
- Plan: primary path = retrieval -> reranker -> top-N. Fallback = retrieval-only path (with a conservative scoring threshold) if reranker latency spikes. We can configure automatic fallback thresholds in the routing policy.

Metrics & instrumentation
- Log per-request: retrieval_latency, reranker_latency, tokens_processed, cost_estimate, topk_candidates_count.
- Eval: compute nDCG@5/10, MRR, Recall@100, and a pairwise preference test for the 300 human-eval queries. We'll also surface per-intent slice metrics (browse vs transactional).

Data handling
- We'll accept anonymized CSVs with columns: query, candidate_id, candidate_text, label (0/1/2), timestamp. If SeekData wants to keep vectors on their side, send the candidate IDs and we'll accept a doc-to-vector mapping API.

I'll prepare a short runbook and a sample metric dashboard before the call. Happy to walk through the SDK snippet and infra considerations in the deep-dive.

— Soojin
